```{r}
# Whether to impute NA genoflu_cluster labels by phylogenetic neighbourhood
# (propagate into monophyletic clades, then nearest tip). Off by default: filling
# only ever assigns an NA tip into an already-monophyletic clade for that label, so
# it can only inflate apparent purity/monophyly relative to GenoFlu's as-assigned
# labels — a biased comparison for evaluating GenoFlu against the phylogeny. Turn on
# only for exploratory/visualization use, not for the monophyly/purity/Faith PD
# comparison. Note Step 2 of fill_clade_labels() computes a full cophenetic distance
# matrix (O(n^2)), which is very slow/memory-heavy at full dataset scale (~40k tips).
fill_genoflu_na<-FALSE
```

```{r}
#note NA is xNA
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  myseg<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  mycol<-which(colnames(genos.all)==myseg)
  if(is.na(myseg)){mycol<-which(colnames(genos.all)=="xNA")}
  # print(colnames(genos.all)[mycol])
  #Add a new column to the meta for this
  tempdf<-genos.all[,c(keepcols,mycol)]
  colnames(tempdf)<-c("sample","genoflu_genotype","genoflu_cluster")
  meta[[i]]<-left_join(meta[[i]], tempdf, by="sample")
}
```

## plot trees including NA labels
```{r}
clade.cols<-replicate(vector,n=l.tr)
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  #trees with tips colored by clade
  segment<-meta[[i]]$segment[1]
  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  meta[[i]]<- meta[[i]][order(is.na(meta[[i]]$genoflu_cluster)), ]
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("X.2","X.1","X")))
  
  #use the same colors in plots below
  # top clusters by frequency get distinctive Okabe-Ito colors; rare clusters get muted purples
  okabe_ito<-c("#E69F00","#56B4E9","#009E73","#F0E442","#0072B2","#D55E00","#CC79A7")
  cl_counts<-sort(table(meta[[i]]$genoflu_cluster[!is.na(meta[[i]]$genoflu_cluster)]),decreasing=TRUE)
  all_clades<-names(cl_counts)
  n_major<-min(length(okabe_ito),length(all_clades))
  major_clades<-all_clades[seq_len(n_major)]
  minor_clades<-all_clades[seq_len(length(all_clades))>n_major]
  major_cols<-setNames(okabe_ito[seq_len(n_major)], major_clades)
  if(length(minor_clades)>0){
    minor_cols<-setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#c9b8e8","#8a6dae"))(length(minor_clades)), minor_clades)
    clade.cols[[i]]<-c(major_cols, minor_cols, "Unassigned"="grey70")
  } else {
    clade.cols[[i]]<-c(major_cols, "Unassigned"="grey70")
  }
  
  #basic tree
  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()+
    geom_treescale(x=0, y=ceiling(NN*0.95),
                   fontsize=3, linesize=0.5, offset=200)

  # Add the clades
  t <- t %<+% meta[[i]]
  t2 <- t +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color=genoflu_cluster, subset=!is.na(genoflu_cluster)),
                  size=0.7, alpha=0.7) +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color="Unassigned", subset=is.na(genoflu_cluster)),
                  size=0.7, alpha=0.7) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_text(face="bold")) +
    ggtitle(segment)+
    scale_color_manual(values=clade.cols[[i]], breaks=names(clade.cols[[i]]))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out, segment,"_cladesTipColor.tiff"),
         width=5,height=7,units="in")
}
```

## Propagate the labels in the tree
this script could be generalized to subtype (NA) and H5 clades/lineages
```{r}
# Post-order propagation function that propagates existing non-NA labels downward to missing tips. Only propagates if all non-NA labels in the current clade are identical (monophyletic). Traverses the tree bottom-up (postorder) so smaller clades are resolved first. libs ape and phangorn.
fill_clade_labels <- function(tree, tip_data, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  # Ensure tip_data matches tree tip order
  tip_data <- tip_data[match(tree$tip.label, tip_data$tip), ]
  # Step 1: Safe propagation (bottom-up)
  postorder_nodes <- rev(postorder(tree))
  internal_nodes <- postorder_nodes[postorder_nodes > Ntip(tree)]
  for (node in internal_nodes) {
    descendants <- Descendants(tree, node, type = "tips")[[1]]
    labels <- tip_data$genoflu_cluster[descendants]
    nonNA_labels <- labels[!is.na(labels)]
    # Only propagate if all non-NA labels are identical
    if (length(nonNA_labels) > 0 && length(unique(nonNA_labels)) == 1) {
      tip_data$genoflu_cluster[descendants][is.na(labels)] <- nonNA_labels[1] 
    }
  }
  
  # Step 2: Fill remaining NAs by nearest labeled tip
  na_tips <- which(is.na(tip_data$genoflu_cluster))
  if (length(na_tips) > 0) {
    nonNA_idx <- which(!is.na(tip_data$genoflu_cluster))
    # Compute pairwise tip distances
    dist_matrix <- cophenetic.phylo(tree)
    for (tip_idx in na_tips) {
      nearest_idx <- nonNA_idx[which.min(dist_matrix[tip_data$tip[tip_idx], tip_data$tip[nonNA_idx]])]
      tip_data$genoflu_cluster[tip_idx] <- tip_data$genoflu_cluster[nearest_idx]
    }
  }
  return(tip_data)
}
```

## Quantify monophyly, Fitch parsimony score (fragmentation) to compare this to the GenoFlu and  clusters (add this and code above for wtihin vs betwen)
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ape);library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(ggplot2)})

set.seed(111)

if(exists("segments.ms"))segments<-segments.ms
segments_positional<-sort(segments)

out_dir<-"cluster_eval"
if(exists("f.out"))out_dir<-f.out
if(!dir.exists(out_dir))dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE)

# fast precompute for rooted binary trees:
# - parent of each node
# - children list per internal node
# - postorder internal nodes (parent after children)
# - descendant tip counts per node
precompute_tree_cache<-function(tree){
  if(!is.rooted(tree))tree<-root(tree,outgroup=tree$tip.label[1],resolve.root=TRUE)
  tree<-reorder.phylo(tree,order="postorder")
  n_tip<-length(tree$tip.label)
  n_all<-n_tip+tree$Nnode
  parent<-integer(n_all)
  parent[tree$edge[,2]]<-tree$edge[,1]
  children<-split(tree$edge[,2],tree$edge[,1])
  post_nodes<-tree$edge[,1]
  post_nodes<-post_nodes[!duplicated(post_nodes)]
  desc_tip_n<-integer(n_all)
  desc_tip_n[seq_len(n_tip)]<-1L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    desc_tip_n[v]<-sum(desc_tip_n[ch])
  }
  edge_len<-numeric(n_all)
  edge_len[tree$edge[,2]]<-tree$edge.length
  list(tree=tree,n_tip=n_tip,n_all=n_all,parent=parent,children=children,post_nodes=post_nodes,desc_tip_n=desc_tip_n,node_depth=node.depth.edgelength(tree),edge_len=edge_len)
}

# Fitch parsimony score for a binary tip character (0/1), unordered, returns minimum # changes
# tree cache must be postorder; children map reused across clusters
fitch_parsimony_binary_cache<-function(cache,x){
  n_all<-cache$n_all
  children<-cache$children
  post_nodes<-cache$post_nodes
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  S0<-logical(n_all);S1<-logical(n_all)
  tip_idx<-seq_len(n_tip)
  S0[tip_idx]<-x==0
  S1[tip_idx]<-x==1
  score<-0L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    i1<-ch[1];i2<-ch[2]
    a0<-S0[i1]&&S0[i2];a1<-S1[i1]&&S1[i2]
    if(a0||a1){
      S0[v]<-a0;S1[v]<-a1
    } else {
      S0[v]<-(S0[i1]||S0[i2]);S1[v]<-(S1[i1]||S1[i2])
      score<-score+1L
    }
  }
  score
}

evaluate_segment_clusters_fast<-function(tree,cluster_df,seg_id,method_id,cluster_col="genoflu_cluster_filled",do_fragmentation=FALSE){
  # exclude unassigned tips
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(cluster_df[[cluster_col]]),,drop=FALSE]
  # prune tree to assigned tips only
  n_orig<-Ntip(tree)
  keep<-intersect(tree$tip.label,cluster_df$seq_new)
  if(length(keep)<n_orig){
    tree<-keep.tip(tree,keep)
    cat("  ",seg_id,"(",method_id,"): pruned to",length(keep),"of",n_orig,"tips\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ",seg_id,"(",method_id,"): all",n_orig,"tips assigned\n")
  }

  # tree cache computed once per segment
  cache<-precompute_tree_cache(tree)
  tree<-cache$tree
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  parent<-cache$parent
  node_depth<-cache$node_depth
  desc_tip_n<-cache$desc_tip_n
  edge_len<-cache$edge_len

  # align cluster assignments to tree tip order
  tip_pos<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(tip_pos),,drop=FALSE]
  cluster_df$tip_idx<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_vec<-rep(NA_character_,n_tip)
  cluster_vec[cluster_df$tip_idx]<-as.character(cluster_df[[cluster_col]])
  if(anyNA(cluster_vec)){
    n_missing<-sum(is.na(cluster_vec))
    stop("Missing cluster assignments after matching to tree tips for segment=",seg_id,"; missing_tips=",n_missing,"/",n_tip)
  }

  clusters<-sort(unique(cluster_vec))
  cluster_indices<-split(seq_len(n_tip),cluster_vec)

  # preallocate per-cluster outputs
  k<-length(clusters)
  cl_nodes<-integer(k)
  cl_sizes<-integer(k)
  cl_purity<-numeric(k)
  cl_type<-character(k)
  cl_frag<-integer(k)
  cl_mrca_depth<-numeric(k)
  cl_mrca_desc_n<-integer(k)
  cl_pd<-numeric(k)

  # Faith's PD: total branch length of the minimal subtree connecting a cluster's
  # tips to their MRCA. Paths are walked tip->MRCA and each edge counted once via
  # a per-cluster stamp (avoids double-counting where paths converge).
  pd_stamp<-integer(cache$n_all)

  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cl<-clusters[ci]
    tips_idx<-cluster_indices[[cl]]
    tips_lab<-tree$tip.label[tips_idx]
    cl_sizes[ci]<-length(tips_idx)

    # MRCA and descendant tip count used for purity; no descendant-tip enumeration
    if(length(tips_idx)==1){
      mrca<-tips_idx
      cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca
      cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
      cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-1L
      cl_purity[ci]<-1
      cl_type[ci]<-"singleton"
      cl_frag[ci]<-0L
      cl_pd[ci]<-0
      next
    }

    mrca<-getMRCA(tree,tips_lab)
    cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca
    cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
    cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-desc_tip_n[mrca]
    cl_purity[ci]<-length(tips_idx)/desc_tip_n[mrca]

    pd<-0
    for(ti in tips_idx){
      node<-ti
      while(node!=mrca&&pd_stamp[node]!=ci){
        pd_stamp[node]<-ci
        pd<-pd+edge_len[node]
        node<-parent[node]
      }
    }
    cl_pd[ci]<-pd

    # fragmentation score computed only if requested
    frag<-NA_integer_
    if(isTRUE(do_fragmentation)){
      x<-rep(0L,n_tip);x[tips_idx]<-1L
      frag<-fitch_parsimony_binary_cache(cache,x)
    } else {
      frag<-NA_integer_
    }
    cl_frag[ci]<-ifelse(is.na(frag),NA_integer_,frag)

    # monophyly/paraphyly/polyphyly classification:
    # monophyletic: purity==1
    # polyphyletic: fragmentation>=2 (membership arises in multiple disjoint regions)
    # paraphyletic: otherwise
    if(cl_purity[ci]==1){
      cl_type[ci]<-"monophyletic"
    } else if(!is.na(frag)&&frag>=2){
      cl_type[ci]<-"polyphyletic"
    } else {
      cl_type[ci]<-"paraphyletic"
    }
  }

  # nested detection using parent-walk with node->cluster map (avoids cluster x cluster matching)
  node_to_cluster<-integer(cache$n_all)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    n<-cl_nodes[ci]
    if(node_to_cluster[n]==0L)node_to_cluster[n]<-ci
  }
  nested_in<-rep(NA_character_,k)
  nested_out_n<-integer(k)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cur<-parent[cl_nodes[ci]]
    while(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]==0L)cur<-parent[cur]
    if(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]>0L){
      nested_in[ci]<-clusters[node_to_cluster[cur]]
      nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]<-nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]+1L
    }
  }

  cl_tbl<-data.frame(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,cluster=clusters,n_tips=as.integer(cl_sizes),type=cl_type,mrca_node=as.integer(cl_nodes),mrca_depth=as.numeric(cl_mrca_depth),mrca_desc_n=as.integer(cl_mrca_desc_n),purity=as.numeric(cl_purity),fragmentation=as.integer(cl_frag),nested_in=as.character(nested_in),nested_out_n=as.integer(nested_out_n),faith_pd=as.numeric(cl_pd),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  seg_tbl<-cl_tbl%>%summarise(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,n_clusters=n(),n_tips_total=sum(n_tips),prop_clusters_monophyletic=mean(type=="monophyletic"),prop_tips_monophyletic=sum(n_tips[type=="monophyletic"])/sum(n_tips),prop_clusters_paraphyletic=mean(type=="paraphyletic"),prop_clusters_polyphyletic=mean(type=="polyphyletic"),mean_purity=mean(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_purity=median(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),mean_fragmentation=mean(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),median_fragmentation=median(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),mean_mrca_depth=mean(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_mrca_depth=median(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),prop_clusters_nested_in=mean(!is.na(nested_in)),mean_faith_pd=mean(faith_pd[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_faith_pd=median(faith_pd[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),mean_faith_pd_per_tip=mean((faith_pd/n_tips)[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_faith_pd_per_tip=median((faith_pd/n_tips)[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

  list(cluster_table=cl_tbl,segment_table=seg_tbl)
}

# inputs expected in each clustering-method evaluation script:
# trees: list of phylo objects across segments in positional alphabetical order
# tc: list of data.frames across segments in the same order, each containing tip.label and cluster
if(!exists("trees"))stop("Object 'trees' not found")
if(!exists("meta"))stop("Object 'meta' not found")
if(length(trees)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: trees=",length(trees),", segments=",length(segments_positional))
if(length(meta)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: meta=",length(meta),", segments=",length(segments_positional))

# set do_fragmentation=FALSE for a large speedup if fragmentation is not required for a given run
do_fragmentation<-FALSE

# QC: NA counts per segment for both cluster columns
cat("=== Cluster column NA counts ===\n")
for(i in seq_along(segments_positional)){
  seg<-segments_positional[i]
  n<-nrow(meta[[i]])
  n_na_orig<-sum(is.na(meta[[i]]$genoflu_cluster))
  n_na_fill<-sum(is.na(meta[[i]]$genoflu_cluster_filled))
  cat(seg,": original NAs =",n_na_orig,"/",n,"| filled NAs =",n_na_fill,"/",n,"\n")
}
cat("================================\n")

# method_id "genoflu" (as-assigned labels only) is what compare_monophyly_clusters.R
# expects; original vs filled are only both evaluated when fill_genoflu_na=TRUE, for
# side-by-side QC (see "Monophyly metric comparison: original vs filled" below).
eval_configs<-if(fill_genoflu_na){
  list(
    list(method_id="genoflu_original", cluster_col="genoflu_cluster"),
    list(method_id="genoflu_filled",   cluster_col="genoflu_cluster_filled")
  )
} else {
  list(list(method_id="genoflu", cluster_col="genoflu_cluster"))
}

cl_all<-list();seg_all<-list()
for(cfg in eval_configs){
  for(i in seq_along(segments_positional)){
    seg<-segments_positional[i]
    cat("Processing segment:",seg,"| method:",cfg$method_id,"\n")
    res<-evaluate_segment_clusters_fast(trees[[i]],meta[[i]],seg,cfg$method_id,
                                        cluster_col=cfg$cluster_col,
                                        do_fragmentation=do_fragmentation)
    cl_all[[paste0(cfg$method_id,"_",seg)]]<-res$cluster_table
    seg_all[[paste0(cfg$method_id,"_",seg)]]<-res$segment_table
  }
}

cluster_metrics_all<-bind_rows(cl_all)
segment_metrics_all<-bind_rows(seg_all)

write.csv(cluster_metrics_all,file=paste0(out_dir,"/genoflu_cluster-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(segment_metrics_all,file=paste0(out_dir,"/genoflu_segment-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

# QC: direct metric comparison between methods
cat("=== Monophyly metric comparison: original vs filled ===\n")
print(segment_metrics_all%>%
  select(segment,method,prop_clusters_monophyletic,prop_tips_monophyletic,mean_purity)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=method,
              values_from=c(prop_clusters_monophyletic,prop_tips_monophyletic,mean_purity)))
cat("=======================================================\n")

for(mid in vapply(eval_configs,function(x)x$method_id,character(1))){
  cm<-cluster_metrics_all%>%filter(method==mid)
  sm<-segment_metrics_all%>%filter(method==mid)

  write.csv(cm,file=paste0(out_dir,"/",mid,"_cluster-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(sm,file=paste0(out_dir,"/",mid,"_segment-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

  plot_long_all<-cm%>%
    mutate(type=factor(type,levels=c("monophyletic","paraphyletic","polyphyletic","singleton")))%>%
    select(segment,type,n_tips,purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols=c(purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth,n_tips),names_to="metric",values_to="value")

  p_all<-ggplot(plot_long_all,aes(x=value,y=log(..count..)))+
    geom_histogram(bins=60)+
    facet_grid(metric~segment,scales="free")+
    plot.theme+
    labs(x=NULL,y="count")
  ggsave(filename=paste0(out_dir,"/",mid,"_all-segments_cluster-metrics_hist.tiff"),plot=p_all,height=10,width=12)

  plot_seg_long<-sm%>%
    select(segment,prop_clusters_monophyletic,prop_tips_monophyletic,mean_purity,mean_mrca_depth,prop_clusters_nested_in)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols=-segment,names_to="metric",values_to="value")

  p_seg<-ggplot(plot_seg_long,aes(x=segment,y=value))+
    geom_col()+
    facet_grid(metric~.,scales="free_y",switch="y")+
    plot.theme+
    labs(x=NULL,y=NULL)
  ggsave(filename=paste0(out_dir,"/",mid,"_all-segments_segment-summaries.tiff"),plot=p_seg,height=12,width=9)
}
```
note on interp:

prop_clusters_monophyletic — fraction of clusters (each weighted equally) that are perfectly monophyletic. A cluster with 2 tips counts the same as one with 500.

prop_tips_monophyletic — fraction of all tips that belong to a monophyletic cluster. Size-weighted, so large well-structured clusters contribute heavily.
